result:
All 14 queries ran against their input files and returned plausible answers. I did not check every answer against the raw data by hand.

Two things to know:
- **U13:** the tag match splits on "," and doesn't trim around each tag, so a tag written with spaces around it would be missed. The hosts I looked at have none.
- **U3, U5, U12:** these return maps and objects, and the outputs I saw came back as maps with plain keys (for example `{"ann": 2, ...}`).

U1: /data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :address | at :city | ne null) | filter ~(/address/city | lower | eq "berlin") | sort ~(/name | lower) | map ~(/name)
U2: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | map ~(at :items | coalesce [] | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2
U3: filter ~(at :items | coalesce [] | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~(/customer) | map ~(count)
U4: :m / | /dependencies | union (m | /devDependencies) | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(/0 | keyword) | distinct | sort
U5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | map ~(count) | entries | map ~({:assignee (/0 | keyword) :count /1}) | sort ~([(/count | desc) /assignee]) | take 3
U6: map ~(at :labels | coalesce []) | flat | map ~(lower) | distinct | sort
U7: lines | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") | map ~(/4 | take (count | sub 2) | parseJson) | avg | round 1
U8: lines | map ~(split " " | /2) | groupBy ~(/) | map ~(count) | entries | map ~({:p (/0 | keyword) :c /1}) | sort ~([(/c | desc) /p]) | take 2 | map ~(/p)
U9: lines | drop 1 | map ~(trim | split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | map ~({:c (/1 | lower) :p (/2 | parseJson)}) | groupBy ~(/c) | map ~(map ~(/p) | avg | round 2)
U10: lines | drop 1 | map ~(trim | split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | filter ~(/3 | ne "0") | map ~({:n /0 :p (/2 | parseJson)}) | sort ~([(/p | desc) /n]) | take 3 | map ~(/n)
U11: :d (/defaults) | /services | entries | map ~({:name (/0 | keyword) :s /1}) | map ~({:name /name :en (/s | at :enabled | coalesce (d | /enabled)) :port (/s | at :port | coalesce (d | /port))}) | filter ~(/en | ne false) | sort ~(/name) | map ~({:name /name :port /port})
U12: groupBy ~(/user) | map ~(sort ~(/ts | desc) | first | /type)
U13: lines | map ~(trim) | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~(startsWith "#" | ne true) | map ~(split "|" | map ~(trim)) | filter ~(/2 | lower | split "," | contains "prod") | map ~(/0 | upper) | sort | join ","
U14: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","fig","Elderberry","cherry","Fig"] | map ~(lower) | distinct | :w / | {:count count :longest (w | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | take 2)}
